leadText: South City (Japanese: サウスシティ South City) is an -exclusive location in Hoenn. It is mentioned in Destiny Deoxys as the hometown of Sid, Rafe, Audrey and Kathryn. It is presumably located opposite of LaRousse City, on the shores of Hoenn mainland, as Rafe, Audrey, and Kathryn were seen leaving the monorail that connects LaRousse City with other cities.
